name: Tunnel crawl
kicker: A widened crawl. The two gates stay separate.
summary: Crawl the widened section if you want the earth around you, then walk the rest above ground. The tourism center prints about 120 meters on two levels and does not say which gate. Bến Dược and Bến Đình are separate sites. Skip the day if you need one ticket and one address for both.
getThere: About 1 hour to Bến Dược, or about 70 km
heroCaption: A tunnel entrance, the lid set in the leaves

notice.title: Two ticket lines, not one total
notice.body: From 1 Feb 2026 the operator prints 35,000 đồng for the historical site and 100,000 đồng for the service and guide, for a foreign visitor, and does not add them. The tourism center and the 23 Apr 2024 press article print 70,000 đồng. A price only for Bến Đình is Check on arrival.

body: You drop through a lid in the leaves, or you come to a round mouth in a mound of earth, and the bore is still tight. The Ho Chi Minh City Tourism Promotion Center prints a widened visitor section of about 120 meters on two levels. That figure is the crawl, not the wartime network, and the center does not say whether those meters are at Bến Dược or at Bến Đình. Minutes underground were not printed. Check on arrival. Most of the visit is the walk above ground.

Bến Dược is the regional command at ấp Phú Hiệp. Keep every address line: xã Ân Nhơn Tây on the operator’s Vietnamese site, xã An Nhơn Tây on the footer and the 19 Jan 2026 notice, and Phu Hiep Hamlet, Phu My Hung Commune, Cu Chi District on the English site. From 1 July 2025 the old xã Phú Mỹ Hưng sits inside xã An Nhơn Tây. Bến Đình is the district-committee base at ấp Bến Đình, xã Nhuận Đức, on Provincial Road 15. The operator’s site still says huyện Củ Chi. Do not use 87A Trần Kế Xương in Phú Nhuận. The operator lists that as a 1955–1958 liaison office, not this ground.

Read the ticket before you pay, and do not pick one kilometre. From 1 Feb 2026 the operator’s foreign notice is 35,000 đồng for the historical site and 100,000 đồng for the service and guide. The service ticket had been 90,000 đồng. The tourism center and Trung tâm Báo chí Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, on 23 Apr 2024, print 70,000 đồng for an international visitor and 35,000 đồng for a Vietnamese adult. A Bến Đình-only price was not printed. Check on arrival. Cục Di sản văn hóa says the tunnels are longer than 200 km, with about 500 km of surface trenches. The press article says about nearly 250 km. The tourism center says the system spreads over more than 250 km². One is a length, one is a shorter length, and one is an area.

figures.caption: A round tunnel mouth in a mound of earth
figures.alt: A round earthen tunnel mouth beside a path, with the bore in the frame

gettingThere: Name the gate before you leave the city. The operator’s homestay note of 31 May 2025 says about one hour by road to Bến Dược and prints no kilometre. Trung tâm Báo chí Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, on 23 Apr 2024, says about 70 km and does not split the gates or print a minute. The tourism center says approximately 70 km northwest, in a sentence that also puts Provincial Road 15 and Phú Hiệp together. Bến Đình’s own kilometres were not printed. Check on arrival. A minute between the two gates was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the city centre
legs.body: By road. About one hour to Bến Dược on the operator’s 31 May 2025 homestay note, with no kilometre. About 70 km on the 23 Apr 2024 press article, gates not split. The tourism center prints a taxi at 600,000–700,000 đồng a trip and does not say which gate. No second fare was printed. Self-drive on the operator’s 4 Jul 2014 note is Trường Chinh, ngã tư An Sương, Hóc Môn, then Provincial Road 15. Minutes for that drive were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: By bus to Bến Dược
legs.body: The operator’s 4 Jul 2014 note: bus 13 from Bến Thành, or 94 from Chợ Lớn, to bến xe Củ Chi, then 79. That note names route 79 “Củ Chi – Dầu Tiếng”. The tourism center prints 13 or 94, then 79 to Bến Dược, and does not use the Dầu Tiếng name. Both descriptions stay. A fare and a minute were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: By bus to Bến Đình
legs.body: The 2014 note and the tourism center agree: bus 13 or 94 to An Sương, 122 to Tân Quy, then 70 to Bến Đình. A fare and a minute were not printed. Check on arrival. This is not the Bến Dược bus.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed. The operator’s 2021 notice includes Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. After 17:00 the grounds are quiet except on a Trăng chiến khu night.
admissionNote: Foreign visitors, operator notice of 19 Jan 2026, from 1 Feb 2026: historical-site admission 35,000 đồng a person a visit, and a service-and-guide ticket 100,000 đồng a person a visit. The notice does not print a combined total and does not print a Vietnamese ticket. The service ticket had been 90,000 đồng. The Ho Chi Minh City Tourism Promotion Center and Trung tâm Báo chí Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, on 23 Apr 2024, print 70,000 đồng for an international visitor and 35,000 đồng for a Vietnamese adult. The tourism center prints no effective date on the 70,000 đồng. The tourism center also prints 50 percent for students and children 7–16, and free entry under 7, for people with disabilities, for the armed forces, and for revolution contributors. The press article prints no child band. A 2005 decision set 15,000 đồng an adult and 7,000 đồng a child from 1 Jan 2006. That is the decision’s own date, not the 2026 notice. The tourism center prints 65,000 đồng a person for the liberated zone. The operator notice does not. A price that belongs only to Bến Đình was not printed. Check on arrival. Shooting, boats, paintball, and extra bicycles are named with no price. Check on arrival.
